recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結內有數個縮小的生發中心，中央可見透明化粉紅色物質與血管，外圍小淋巴球排列成一圈圈同心環狀的洋蔥皮（onion skinning）外套區，濾泡間血管增生，是透明血管型 Castleman 病的典型低倍表現。
features: Multiple small regressed germinal centers, one containing hyalinized eosinophilic material and a vessel
Broad mantle zones with small lymphocytes in concentric rings (onion-skin pattern)
Interfollicular areas with prominent small vessels and hyalinized vessel walls
Monotonous small mature lymphocytes throughout without large atypical cells
Nodal architecture shows follicles crowded without distinct sinuses in this field
describe_en: Low-power view of a lymph node shows follicles with small, atretic germinal centers, one of which contains hyalinized eosinophilic material and a central vessel. The surrounding mantle zones are expanded, with small lymphocytes arranged in concentric rings imparting an onion-skin appearance. The interfollicular stroma shows increased small vessels with hyalinized walls, and no sinuses are evident in this field. No atypical large cell population is seen. Findings are consistent with Castleman disease, hyaline vascular type.

ddx.vs: Follicular lymphoma has back-to-back neoplastic follicles with attenuated mantles and BCL2-positive germinal centers, not small regressed centers with thick onion-skin mantles.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: MCL mantles consist of cyclin D1/SOX11-positive, CD5-positive clonal cells, whereas Castleman mantle cells are polyclonal and cyclin D1-negative.

ddx.dx: Nonspecific reactive hyperplasia with regressed follicles
ddx.vs: Reactive nodes lack the consistent concentric mantle layering, penetrating hyalinized vessels and hypervascular interfollicular stroma across the node.
